graph.name: Smart Garden IoT and Notification System
graph.notes: This architecture describes an internet-connected small garden system that monitors plant health and provides guidance to users via a mobile application. It leverages AWS IoT Core for device data ingestion, Lambda for processing, Pinpoint for push notifications, and API Gateway for handling user feedback.

nodes.name: Garden Device
nodes.notes: Internet-connected small garden device with sensors (water level, humidity, temperature) running FreeRTOS and sending state updates.

nodes.name: Mobile Application
nodes.notes: User's mobile application for receiving push notifications (e.g., low water alerts) and providing feedback or actions back to the system.

nodes.name: IoT Core
nodes.notes: Ingests sensor data from garden devices via MQTT and utilizes the device shadow service to replicate garden state, triggering topic rules for further processing.

nodes.name: Garden Logic Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes state changes from IoT Core topic rules, combines metadata, and interacts with Pinpoint for notifications or updates Pinpoint based on user feedback.

nodes.name: Pinpoint
nodes.notes: Sends targeted push notifications to users based on garden state (e.g., low water), manages user segments, journeys, and campaign interactions.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Provides an endpoint for the mobile application to send user feedback and actions (e.g., 'watered plant', 'ignored notification') back to the system.

edges.notes: Sensor readings (water level, relative humidity, temperature) sent from the garden device via MQTT to IoT Core's device shadow.
IoT Core topic rule triggers Lambda upon detection of specific garden state changes (e.g., low water level).
Lambda sends enriched garden state information and user details to Pinpoint to initiate a targeted push notification campaign.
Pinpoint sends push notifications (e.g., 'Your garden needs water!') to the user's mobile application.
User actions or feedback (e.g., 'I watered my plant', 'acknowledged notification') sent from the mobile application to API Gateway.
API Gateway forwards user feedback requests to Lambda for processing and association of meta information.

Lambda updates Pinpoint attributes or segments based on user feedback to influence future notification strategy (e.g., increasing aggressiveness for ignored notifications or giving credit for positive actions).
